results.title: The Lorraine
results.overview: Renowned documentarian Sam Pollard tells the astonishing, inspiring story of the Lorraine Motel in Memphis, Tennessee, site of the assassination of Reverend Martin Luther King, Jr., and its remarkable owners, Walter and Loree Bailey.

results.title: Lamhaat
results.overview: Lamhaat weaves together six standalone stories set against India's modern city life, each capturing a fleeting moment of longing, guilt, shock, alienation, delusion and regret. Together, they examine how a single instant can reshape a life and leave feelings that linger long after.

results.title: Sisters of the Shattered Moon
results.overview: When a teenage girl discovers the corruption of her futuristic suburban idyll in the clouds, she is expelled to a vast underworld of endless night.

results.title: Karo Dame, Herz König
results.overview: Svenja longs to be closer to her father Ralf. Throughout her life, the globetrotter and multiple family founder was more often away than at home. When Ralf is diagnosed with terminal cancer, it suddenly becomes unclear whether they can overcome the distance that has grown between them. A seemingly mundane family tradition helps: playing rummy.

results.title: Zico: O Samurai de Quintino
results.overview: The film explores Zico's personality through previously unseen archival footage, revealing stories from his time with Flamengo, the National Team, and in Japan—balancing discipline and legacy.

results.title: The Other Side of the Bridge
results.original_title: The Other Side of the Bridge
results.overview: A former teenage boxing champion returns to the ring to save his trainer’s gym, facing a rival from a different part of Lagos.

results.title: Richard Bona With the hr Big Band
results.original_title: Richard Bona Avec le big band de la Radio de Francfort
results.overview: Richard Bona was born in Cameroon. He was 10 years old when he built his first bass guitar out of a cardboard box and bicycle brake cables. Now based in New York, this collaborator of Herbie Hancock, Chick Corea, and Sting has won over audiences with his Afro-influenced music and his multilingual vocals. The Frankfurt Radio Big Band is conducted by Michael Philip Mossman.

results.title: Night of Silence
results.overview: In preparation for their Christmastime performance, a youth choir spends the night at their church. One lonely chorister is taken under the wing of his female chaperone, and the two form a mysterious connection.

results.title: I Need an Intervention Later
results.overview: He's going to get addicted to drugs later on. A Funny Lifestyle short.

results.title: We Are Wild
results.overview: When a young abused housewife runs away from home she finds herself in a 1970’s utopia in the woods with a ragtag group of misfit hippies. Is she free or did she give up one prison for another?

results.title: Psycho
results.overview: A psychological thriller exploring the fragile boundary between perception and reality, where characters confront their inner demons and moral conflicts while navigating suspense-driven events that challenge identity, truth, and human nature.

results.title: Change
results.overview: Cape Town. 2025. Ruan, a managing director of a large corporation, realises he’s being ambushed by a new cashless policy enforced by their mother company in the UK. From the perspective of a two-rand coin, we watch as Ruan tries to stop the inevitable. Along the way, we get glimpses into the lives of city-dwelling South Africans, with each character portraying a different socioeconomic class and perspective on money. The film shows what change represents to the distinct yet connected ensemble of characters and asks: What is the significance of coins in a time when tap to pay is the order of the day? And at what cost are we going cashless?

results.title: Scenes of Friendly Ties
results.overview: One winter day and one night in the lives of thirty-year-old friends, former classmates. They must overcome everyday difficulties to meet and see off Sasha, who is leaving Moscow for an extended period.

results.title: Indelible
results.overview: Arthur, a pretentious documentary filmmaker, is shooting a new film about the world of tattooing. When he meets an Auschwitz survivor in a park, he decides to completely shift the focus of the film to dedicate it to the man's testimony. However, his partner is wary: what are his true motives?

results.title: Camp Blood Legacy
results.overview: A group of college friends run into the infamous killer clown at Camp Black Tree as he slices and dices his way through them. One year later, the sole survivor returns with her friends to settle the score, once and for all.  This is the "lost" original version of Camp Blood 4 and Camp Blood 5, first released in 2016. Starring Schuylar Craig (Nemesis 5) and Jennii Caroline from the Meathook Massacre series. From cult filmmaker Dustin Ferguson (Witchcraft XVII, Spider Baby).

results.title: Ian Fleming and the Curse of James Bond
results.original_title: Ian Fleming and the Curse of James Bond
results.overview: A film exploring Ian Fleming's espionage career, relentless habits, and tropical retreat in Jamaica, which shaped the fictional secret service agent, while detailing his tragic struggle to escape a character that overshadowed his legacy.
